title: Databricks Acquires Microsoft Excel Competitor Row Zero
summary: <p>Databricks is <a href="https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-acquires-row-zero-bringing-live-governed-spreadsheets">acquiring</a> Row Zero, a five-year-old Microsoft Excel competitor that sells spreadsheet software that’s designed for analyzing massive amounts of data.</p> <p>The deal could help Databricks attract more non-technical users to Genie, a chatbot it launched last summer that lets business ...</p>
